description: This file defines the ContentTranslationMetadataWrapper class, which provides methods to access and modify metadata related to content translation in Drupal, such as source, author, publication status, and timestamps.

classes.name: ContentTranslationMetadataWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing content translation metadata, including source, author, status, and timestamps, for Drupal entities.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Retrieves the source of the content translation.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source of the content translation.

methods.name: isOutdated
methods.description: Checks if the translation is marked as outdated.

methods.name: setOutdated
methods.description: Marks the translation as outdated or not.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Retrieves the author of the translation, either from a specific field or the owner.

methods.name: setAuthor
methods.description: Sets the author of the translation.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Checks if the translation is published.

methods.name: setPublished
methods.description: Sets the publication status of the translation.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Retrieves the creation timestamp of the translation.

methods.name: setCreatedTime
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the translation.

methods.name: getChangedTime
methods.description: Retrieves the last changed timestamp of the translation.

methods.name: setChangedTime
methods.description: Sets the last changed timestamp of the translation.

methods.name: setFieldOnlyIfTranslatable
methods.description: Updates a field value only if the field is translatable.
